title: Script | ESP, Aimbot, Loot Finder [NO KEY]
features:
Aftermath script with ESP, aimbot, item ESP and an inventory tracker — no key, works on mobile and PC.

[+] Player ESP — boxes, names, distance, chams
[+] Zombie ESP — tells sprinters, crawlers and skinned apart on sight so you know what's coming
[+] Animal ESP — bears, buck, doe, fawn
[+] Car ESP — every vehicle on the map, visible at any range
[+] Loot ESP — real item names + rarity colours, filter by weapons / ammo / attachments / armor / meds / food
[+] Container ESP — skips already-empty containers so you stop wasting time
[+] INV TRACKER — records what players are carrying, with 3D item icons and weight bars
[+] Player Loadout Viewer — their guns, live ammo counts and gear tiers
[+] Aimbot — hold to aim, FOV + smoothness sliders, lock distance, target zombies or players
[+] Bullet Drop Compensation + Target Leading for long range
[+] Fully mobile friendly, RightShift to hide
& more...

No key, no discord, no linkvertise.
